name: POWER
recent: POWER 于 2025 年 10 月完成 IPO，并在 2026 年 10 月出现多名董事及大股东权益变动，包括 offer for sale 及认购。2026 年 11 月公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
notable: 公司于 2025 年 10 月进行首次公开募股 (IPO)，并计划于 2025 年 10 月 28 日上市。
2026 年 10 月 29 日，多名董事及大股东出现权益变动，包括 offer for sale 及认购。
2026 年 10 月 29 日，董事会出现变动，涉及 MR LEONG CHEE FEI、MISS CLESSENSE KHO MEI CHEE 及 MR CHOO CHEE YONG。
risks: 2026 年 9 月，执行董事 MISS CLESSENSE KHO MEI CHEE 及首席财务官 MR CHIN YANJIANG 在公开市场出售公司股份。
2026 年 10 月 29 日，董事会出现变动，涉及三名董事。

recent_en: POWER completed its IPO in October 2025 and saw multiple changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests in October 2026, including an offer for sale and subscriptions. It announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 in November 2026.
notable_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) in October 2025, with a tentative listing date of 28 October 2025.
On 29 October 2026, several directors and substantial shareholders had changes in their interests, including an offer for sale and subscriptions.
On 29 October 2026, there were changes in the boardroom involving MR LEONG CHEE FEI, MISS CLESSENSE KHO MEI CHEE and MR CHOO CHEE YONG.
risks_en: In September 2026, Executive Director MISS CLESSENSE KHO MEI CHEE and Chief Financial Officer MR CHIN YANJIANG disposed of company shares in the open market.
On 29 October 2026, there were boardroom changes involving three directors.
